title: Pantrybox — Checkout
objective: Check out and pay for exactly what is in your cart — or get items into an order that you did not pay for.

verifier.condition: An order's items are worth at least $10 more than the amount authorized for it.

weakness: Checkout totals the cart and authorizes the card for that amount (a slow call) and only afterwards builds the order lines from the live cart, while the add-to-cart endpoint is not locked, so items added during authorization are shipped but never paid for.
seededData: Account alice with a cart holding one tea tin and a small catalogue of products. In memory; reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Customer
credentials.note: Has a cart with one item.

hints: Checkout takes a noticeable moment. Work out what the server is doing during that time, and what it has already decided.
Two different endpoints touch the same cart. Each is correct alone; ask what each assumes the other is not doing.
Start checkout, and while it is still waiting add an expensive item to the cart from another request.
burpNotes: Note how long checkout takes to answer, and which endpoint changes the cart.
